prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1178; do not mention it.)
text:
We represent the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above, and we write to notify you that all further communication regarding this matter must be directed exclusively to this office. Please do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person, and please refer any inquiries from our client's representatives to us.

Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision and is currently receiving medical care. Given the nature of the impact and the ongoing treatment, we request that you provide a complete statement of the applicable policy limits for each coverage that may respond to this claim, including bodily injury and any medical payments coverage, along with a copy of the declarations page.

We also ask that your insured, and your company, take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, witness statements, claim file materials, repair estimates, telematics records, and any recorded statements. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained and will not be altered, repaired, or discarded while this matter is pending.
